settings.hero_desc: A detailed scale model of a modular cabin / container home - wood-finish walls, a timber deck and a removable roof that reveals the interior layout. The ideal sales and presentation tool for modular-home and cabin builders.
settings.perso_placeholder: Your unit design, finishes, scale and base
settings.s1_body: A modular home sells best when buyers can see exactly what they're getting. This cabin model captures the exterior - wood cladding, deck and canopy - and lifts off at the roof to reveal the interior layout inside. Built to scale from your plans, it is the perfect showroom, sales-meeting and exhibition tool for container-home and modular-cabin builders.
settings.case_body: Built for a modular-home builder, this cabin model let the sales team show the exterior and lift the roof to reveal the layout - answering buyers' questions in one tangible piece, far better than drawings alone.
settings.case_quote: Lifting the roof to show the inside seals the deal every time. Brilliant sales tool.
settings.prov_p: For modular and container homes, the interior is the product. A model that opens up lets buyers experience the layout - the fastest way to turn interest into a sale.
